detail.longDescription: Cairn isn't a to-do app, on purpose. No due dates, no sub-tasks, no streaks to break, no guilt badge when you come back after a week. Those are exactly what turn a productivity tool into a second job. It's a way to start: name the next step, make it smaller, carve it. One stone, then the next, and the pile shows you how far you've come. https://www. bitoftek.com/cairn/ # Productivity # Neurodivergent # ADHD # AuDHD
